0022600138.text: The Rockets, 4-0 and first in the Southwest, arrive at 2-0 on the road, while the Bucks are 1-3 and 13th in the East, five games... wait, 5th in the Central and 2 games back. Houston will be without Alperen Sengun (out, back soreness), Marcus Smart (out, forearm strain), and Steven Adams (out, calf strain). This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, following a 2-0 Rockets sweep last season and a 119-113 Houston win on April 1 in Houston.
